Image compressor

Choose images and make them smaller. You can also ask for a target size in KB.

How it works

  1. Choose your images.
  2. Pick a quality, or type a target size in KB.
  3. Click Compress and download the smaller files.

Good to know

  • With a target size, the tool lowers quality and, if needed, the picture size until it fits.
  • Very small targets can make a picture look blurry. Check the result before you use it.

Common questions

How do I compress an image to 100 KB?

Type 100 in the target size box and click Compress. The tool finds the best quality that fits.

Does compression lose quality?

Yes, a little. Lower quality means a smaller file, so choose the balance that looks fine to you.
